dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We analyzed a heterogeneous dataset comprising 326 MS patients from five sources: three in-house datasets (Lausanne University Hospital (CHUV), Louvain Neuroinflammation Imaging Lab (NIL), and Imaging Axonal Damage & Repair in Multiple Sclerosis (INsIDER) [ 20]) and two public datasets (MICCAIMSSEG2016 challenge [ 8] and OpenMSLong [ 30])."

age.detail: Weighted mean across five datasets using dataset N and mean; min/max from dataset ranges; SD not reported
